Trans is an umbrella term for transgender and transsexual people. Q - Queer/Questioning. Queer is an umbrella term for all of those who are not heterosexual and/or cisgender. Questioning is when a person isn't 100% sure of their sexual orientation and/or gender, and are trying to find their true identity. I - Intersex. Intersex is when a person has an indeterminate mix of primary and secondary sex characteristics. A - Asexuality.
